integrity: The infinite-iteration theorem is analytically proved. The exact rational witness and a standalone verifier are included. Self-review is not independent validation or certification.
scientific_limitations: Fixed positive base step and real scalar (1,-1) stage-weight correction of SSPRK(2,2); finite uncoupled planar rotations, exact arithmetic, one total Euclidean quadratic norm; other corrections, time-step changes, nonlinear flows and weighted Hamiltonians not covered.
title: Finite-step loss of an energy-conserving Runge–Kutta correction on skew oscillators
